narrative.overview:
HagiCode Fullstack is a tutorial, so the lesson text is the product and everything else is margin. The system looks like a well-set workbook: white page, near-black ink, a single blue reserved for links, and thin grey rules that organise the page without decorating it. Nothing glows, nothing floats. A reader arrives to read a lesson, tick it off, and move to the next one.

The interface earns trust by working before anything else loads. Every page is static HTML; the course switcher, language switcher and outline are native `details` elements and real links, and the only client script restores read marks and the continue target from this browser. Components are built so that the page reads in full without that script, and so that its absence is invisible rather than broken. Dark mode follows the visitor's `prefers-color-scheme`; there is no theme switch.

The system is built on shadcn/ui (`radix-nova` style, `neutral` base colour, CSS variables) rendered to static HTML. It inherits the shadcn vocabulary of tokens, radii and `data-slot` hooks, and keeps the site-specific pieces small: a reading column, a lesson layout with a sticky outline, and a progress vocabulary of count, bar and read marker.
keyCharacteristics: Text first: a 42rem reading column, body line-height 1.7, one `h1` per page.
Achromatic surfaces with one blue (link-blue) for links and focus; the neutral ramp carries all hierarchy.
Flat depth: surfaces are separated by a hairline ring or border, never by shadow.
State is never colour alone: read state is an icon swap plus screen-reader text; the current lesson is bold plus a surface plus `aria-current`.
Works without scripting; progress UI is hidden or neutral until `ProgressRuntime` fills it in.
Ten locales: every label must tolerate long German, French or Russian strings and CJK without breaking the layout.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only as link text and the global focus outline. It never fills a surface, and a second accent colour is not added without a change to this file.

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: In `global.css`, `--color-accent` and `--color-muted` as CSS variables keep their legacy text-colour meaning (link blue and soft ink), while the `accent` and `muted` utilities and shadcn components mean surfaces (Quiet Surface). Read the token's role before reaching for the variable.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Components take colour from tokens through utilities (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`). Raw hex or oklch values do not appear in components.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: Each page has exactly one `h1`. The site header is a link, not a heading, so it does not compete.

rules.name: The Native Stack Rule
rules.body: No web font is loaded. Weight and colour carry hierarchy; a decorative display face is not introduced.

rules.name: The Rails Stay Put Rule
rules.body: The top bar and the sidebar are the fixed frame; the page itself scrolls under them with the browser's own scrolling. Do not turn the main pane into a nested scroll container, because find-in-page, scroll position and the end-of-lesson read mark all depend on the window scrolling.

rules.name: The Column Before The Grid Rule
rules.body: Content starts from a single measured column. Add the sidebar pane only where the page has a tree to navigate; home and overview content does not become a dashboard.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add `box-shadow` to a component to make it feel raised. If a surface needs separation, give it the ring or the border.

rules.name: The Focus Is Visible Rule
rules.body: Plain links and unstyled interactive elements get the global 2px Link Blue outline with a 3px offset; shadcn controls get a border of Focus Grey plus a 3px ring at 50% opacity. Never remove an outline without replacing it.

dos: **Do** use the token utilities (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`, `ring-foreground/10`) and keep dark values in `global.css` under `prefers-color-scheme`.
**Do** keep one `h1` per page and use the Display step only for it.
**Do** render new components as static HTML with native elements first (`details`, `a`, `button`); add script only through `ProgressRuntime` hooks.
**Do** pair every state with a second cue besides colour: an icon, weight, text or an ARIA attribute.
**Do** let labels wrap or truncate deliberately for ten locales; use `min-w-0` in flex and grid children and `whitespace-normal` on buttons that carry titles.
**Do** keep primary actions full width below `sm` and auto width from `sm`.
**Do** put a navigable tree in the sidebar pane and let everything else live in the one measured column.
**Do** add new shadcn primitives with `npx shadcn add <name>` and keep the `radix-nova` style.
donts: **Don't** make the main pane scroll inside its own box; the window scrolls.
**Don't** add a theme toggle; dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
**Don't** add `box-shadow`, gradients, glass or decorative imagery to make a surface feel richer.
**Don't** use Link Blue as a fill or introduce a second accent colour.
**Don't** use hex, oklch or pixel literals in components when a token or a scale step exists.
**Don't** rely on `--color-accent` or `--color-muted` as surface colours; they are text colours.
**Don't** add a `client:*` directive or ship a hydration script for a presentational component.
**Don't** load a web font or set body copy outside the 42rem reading column.
**Don't** hand-write `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt` or an icon into `public/`; Hagilight generates them.
